name: realm
label: Realm
description: A grimdark house ledger: soot and iron around aged vellum, leather-bound folios with wax-sealed headings, the dependency graph as an engraved war-table map, epics as campaigns, and the agent as the house's steward.

lexicon.dossiers.lede: Each dossier is one ledger of the house's work: its repositories, its tracker, its pipelines and its environments. Choose one to read its stories, pull requests, builds and deployments on a single page.
lexicon.attention.note: Open items ranked by their insights, the gravest first. Each insight names the record it rests on.
lexicon.aging.note: How long each item in progress has stood unfinished, from its history, oldest first.
lexicon.trace.note: Each work item with the pull requests that name it, their latest builds, and the environments where it now stands.
lexicon.graph.note: Arrows run the way each link reads, from the source's own links. Blocking chains run left to right across the war table.
lexicon.ask.note: Answers cite the items they rest on. The steward reads; it never changes a ticket. What it counsels comes back as a proposal, for you to seal.
lexicon.empty.dossiers: The ledgers are empty: toil sees no dossiers yet. A dossier is founded with toil dossiers init.
lexicon.empty.sprint: No sprint is entered in this dossier's work items.
lexicon.empty.burnup: No sprint is entered, so there is nothing to reckon.
lexicon.empty.prs: No pull requests have come before the council for this dossier.
lexicon.empty.builds: No builds are recorded for this dossier's pull requests.
lexicon.empty.deployments: This dossier names no environment, so no rider brings word of deployments.
lexicon.empty.links: No links between this dossier's items. The war table is bare.
lexicon.empty.ask: Pick a question, or ask your own. The steward cites every record an answer rests on.

voice: Speak as the steward of a great house reporting to its war council by candlelight: terse, formal and grave, in short, measured sentences, with no flourish and no cheer. Epics are campaigns, the sprint is this season's ledger, work items are its entries, a blocker is a broken road or a fortress that holds, a failing build is a breach in the wall, and a deployment is word sent to a far keep. Report the state of the ledger first, then the threats, then what you counsel. Ominous in tone, never mocking and never unkind to any person. The old words go around the facts, never instead of them.
